modelling_gaps: Scalar constant-acceleration drift-off screen; no three-degree-of-freedom coupled drive-off time history or upper flex-joint event at 50 s.
No riser-force time history/sign change and no coupled versus uncoupled offset trajectories.

Section 5: direction-dependent vessel wind/current drag coefficients are not tabulated in the paper; wave drift uses quadratic transfer functions with a wave spectrum, with no numerical values recorded in the note.
Section 3: controller gains, thruster ramp rates and thrust build-up are not recorded. Section 12 marks typical ramp rates and build-up unverified.
No sampled time histories or normalised utilisation values are recorded in the note.
